templates.name: Agent Architecture View
templates.description: Brief stub: stack, quick-start, layer names — links to architecture/high-level.md and low-level.md for the actual map and rationale, never restates them

templates.name: Agent Pattern Exemplars
templates.description: Complexity hotspots, function exemplars, recurring-import table — has no other home in the human tree, so this is the one docs/agents/ file with real (non-stub) content

templates.name: Agent Glossary View
templates.description: Brief stub: a linking view over reference/glossary.md — never redefines a term

templates.name: Agent Testing View
templates.description: Brief stub: runner command, layout note, single-test command — links to engineering/testing.md for strategy

templates.name: Agent Tech-Debt Pointer
templates.description: Brief stub linking to architecture/tech-debt.md; real content only for gaps that are genuinely agent-specific and absent there

templates.name: Agent Flow View
templates.description: Brief stub: entry points and triggers per domain, sourced from the domain graph — links to docs/flows/<flow>.md for actual steps

templates.name: Agent Conventions
templates.description: Existing CONVENTIONS.md distilled into AI-targeted directives — only built if CONVENTIONS.md exists in the repo

templates.name: Claude Code Settings
templates.description: Machine config: permissions.deny + hooks.Stop, derived from the manifests the same way engineering/setup.md derives its install command. Merged on re-runs, never overwritten.
